entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A hieromancer and planeswalker born Kytheon Iora on Theros, a fiercely loyal warrior-mage who can make himself invulnerable and who belonged to the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A multiplanar coalition of planeswalkers founded by Gideon, Jace, Chandra and Nissa, who swore an oath to stand together against threats too large to face alone.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker whom Gideon first tracked across planes and who later became a founding member of the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker whom Gideon saved by taking her demonic contract upon himself.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath planeswalker and Gatewatch founder, the expert on leylines.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An animist planeswalker and Gatewatch founder who raised hedrons around Ulamog.

entities.name: Hixus
entities.description: The prison warden who taught Kytheon hieromancy; in the revised origin he freed the prisoners to defend the Kolophon.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of Theros who championed Kytheon against the titan of Erebos.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god of Theros who deflected Kytheon's spear, killing his irregulars, and who later appeared to Gideon in an Emrakul-induced illusion.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of Gideon's birth, where he was raised in a slum of Akros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: The city on Theros where Gideon was born in a slum.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: The plane of the Purifying Fire and the Order of Heliud.

entities.name: Order of Heliud
entities.description: The group on Regatha that watched over the Purifying Fire.

entities.name: Walbert
entities.description: The head of the Regathan Order who planned to offer Chandra to the Purifying Fire; Chandra destroyed him.

entities.name: Purifying Fire
entities.description: A large fountain of white mana in the shape of fire on Regatha, tended by the Order of Heliud.

entities.name: Diraden
entities.description: A plane dominated by black mana and endless night, ruled by a Vampire prince.

entities.name: Prince Velrav
entities.description: The Vampire prince of Diraden, beheaded by Chandra.

entities.name: Falia
entities.description: A menarch on Diraden who looked like a child and plotted to separate Chandra from Gideon.

entities.name: Jurl
entities.description: A goblin, Chandra's last ally on Diraden, who became their guide.

entities.name: Samir Mia Kaulda
entities.description: Chandra's woodland friend on Regatha.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A tempestuous plane invaded by the Eldrazi, where Gideon fought alongside refugees.

entities.name: Fort Keff
entities.description: A settlement on Zendikar near the Eye of Ugin, overrun by the Eldrazi brood.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that darkened the skies over Fort Keff and was later sealed into the moon of Innistrad.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan trapped by hedrons and destroyed on Zendikar.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan summoned by Ob Nixilis and destroyed on Zendikar.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who followed Nissa to Zendikar, summoned Kozilek and defeated Jace, Nissa and Gideon.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A Zendikari city that fell to the Eldrazi and was retaken by Gideon's army.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: A safe zone on Zendikar for refugees.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: Gideon's merfolk friend, trapped at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A roil-mage leader whom Gideon manipulated into helping at Sky Rock.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker native to Zendikar who brought merfolk and sea monsters to the fight.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A leader of the Boros Legion who offered Gideon a battalion to command.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose soldiers Gideon took command of.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A guild-run plane where Gideon sought help and later fought Bolas.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Soratami who helped seal Emrakul into the moon of Innistrad and declined a place in the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the Battle of Thraben was fought against Emrakul.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where the Gatewatch faced Tezzeret and the Consulate.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A rogue planeswalker on Kaladesh experimenting in the Aether Spire.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A Kaladeshi artificer who told the Gatewatch of Tezzeret's location.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Gideon inducted into the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert plane ruled by Nicol Bolas's god-pharaohs and trials.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who recognized Gideon as Kytheon Iora; later a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who ruled the trial of Ambition and judged Gideon not a heretic.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who prophesied that Gideon would die by immortal hands.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: An aspirant on Amonkhet whom Gideon protected.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon planeswalker who defeated the Gatewatch on Amonkhet and was despark on Ravnica.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A soul-drinking sword Gideon used to kill Belzenlok and Rhonas; it broke against Bolas.

entities.name: Sural
entities.description: Gideon's distinctive weapon of four whip-like blades on his armguard, lost in the fight with Bolas.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Gideon and Liliana fought Belzenlok.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon whom Gideon killed with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's zombified brother who led Belzenlok's revenants.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The final confrontation with Bolas on Ravnica.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Bolas's artifact that trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica; Chandra disabled it and Gideon had her reactivate it.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A God-Eternal killed by Gideon with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A demon lord who caught Gideon and brought him within reach of Bolas.

entities.name: Gideon's Promise
entities.description: A pegasus named by Aurelia that Gideon rode.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon whose distraction helped Liliana despark Bolas.

entities.name: Battle of Thraben
entities.description: The battle on Innistrad against Emrakul.

events.summary: Kytheon, a gang leader in the slums of Akros, steals from the rich to feed the poor.
events.quote: taking only what they needed to survive and giving the rest away to the poor

events.summary: Caught and imprisoned, Gideon is taken by a teacher who instructs him in hieromancy.
events.quote: intending to rehabilitate Gideon by teaching him Hieromancy, the magic of order

events.summary: Gideon's spark ignites after he kills a much stronger opponent, and he slips into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Gideon's spark ignited when he killed a much stronger opponent.

events.summary: In the revised origin, Kytheon throws Heliod's spear at Erebos, who redirects it and kills all his irregulars; ashamed, he makes his first planeswalk to Bant and becomes Gideon.
events.quote: Erebos easily changed the course of the spear, killing all the irregulars.

events.summary: Gideon seeks the Purifying Fire on Regatha and is tasked by Walbert with recovering Chandra.
events.quote: tasked Gideon with recovering the planeswalker known as Chandra Nalaar

events.summary: Gideon follows Chandra to Kephalai and incapacitates her to save lives, later returning the Dragon Scroll.
events.quote: in an attempt to save innocent lives, he incapacitated Chandra

events.summary: On Diraden Gideon and Chandra are captured by the Fog Riders after Falia's plot; Gideon kills one Fog Rider.
events.quote: Gideon showed up at an opportune moment and slew one of the Fog Riders

events.summary: Chandra beheads Prince Velrav during his ritual, ending Diraden's Eternal Night.
events.quote: Chandra beheaded the prince

events.summary: Walbert reveals he plans to offer Chandra to the Purifying Fire; Gideon, guilt-ridden, finds a way for her to survive.
events.quote: he planned to offer Chandra to the Purifying Fire

events.summary: The Fire spares Chandra and she destroys Walbert and his guards; Gideon promises to cover for her.
events.quote: The Fire spared Chandra and left her intact

events.summary: Gideon is told tales of the violent land at Fort Keff and hears a surrakar warn of gods from the void.
events.quote: The beast warned him of its gods who came from beyond the world

events.summary: Gideon turns the tide against the brood at Fort Keff until Emrakul darkens the skies; he orders everyone to flee.
events.quote: Gideon told all the beings of the fort to flee

events.summary: On Ravnica Gideon accepts command of Boros soldiers from Aurelia but refuses membership.
events.quote: accepted command of the soldiers, shirking her offer of membership

events.summary: Gideon recruits Jace, rescues Sea Gate survivors and retrieves Jori En, then takes command of the refugees at Sky Rock.
events.quote: They arrived in time to rescue several survivors from Sea Gate

events.summary: Gideon manipulates Noyan Dar into joining the retaking of Sea Gate by exploiting his hubris.
events.quote: Gideon had used his hubris against him as manipulation to get him to offer his help

events.summary: Gideon's army, joined by Kiora and Nissa, retakes Sea Gate and Ulamog is trapped with hedrons.
events.quote: The Eldrazi were driven from the city

events.summary: Ob Nixilis summons Kozilek and defeats Jace, Nissa and Gideon, capturing and torturing them until Chandra frees them.
events.quote: He summoned Kozilek and defeated Jace, Nissa, and Gideon.

events.summary: The four planeswalkers swear an oath and found the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Thus they swore an oath to stand together and founded the Gatewatch

events.summary: Chandra burns Ulamog and Kozilek through the ley lines, destroying both titans.
events.quote: In one brilliant blaze of flame, Ulamog and Kozilek were incinerated and destroyed

events.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, Liliana helps the Gatewatch; Gideon is trapped in an illusion with Erebos, freed by Jace, while Emrakul is sealed in the moon.
events.quote: Gideon was trapped in a scene where he was confronted again by Erebos

events.summary: Gideon and Jace decide to offer Liliana the place in the Gatewatch that Tamiyo declined.
events.quote: Jace and Gideon talked and decided to offer Liliana the place instead

events.summary: On Kaladesh, Gideon clashes with Chandra and Liliana over how the Gatewatch should treat the Consulate.
events.quote: Gideon reminded her that the purpose of the Gatewatch was not traveling from plane to plane to impose their judgment

events.summary: Gideon destroys a Gearhulk with his indestructible body, then he and Chandra destroy the planar bridge from inside a thopter; Tezzeret escapes.
events.quote: He destroyed the Gearhulk by placing his indestructible body between the gears, causing it to collapse.

events.summary: Gideon inducts Ajani into the Gatewatch.
events.quote: Gideon inducted Ajani into the Gatewatch

events.summary: On Amonkhet Oketra recognizes Gideon as Kytheon Iora and he pledges himself to her to face the trials.
events.quote: pledging himself to her to face the Trials of the Five Gods

events.summary: At the trial before Bontu, Gideon defies her demand for a heart, and she declares him not a heretic.
events.quote: Gideon defied her, to the shock of the crop crowd

events.summary: Gideon shields Djeru from Hazoret, who prophesies that he will die by immortal hands.
events.quote: Hazoret prophesied to him that he would die by immortal hands

events.summary: Bolas defeats the Gatewatch; Gideon is severely wounded, loses his sural and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Gideon was severely wounded, lost his sural, and barely managed to planeswalk away.

events.summary: Gideon and Liliana defeat Belzenlok on Dominaria, with Gideon killing him using the Blackblade.
events.quote: which he ultimately used to kill Belzenlok

events.summary: Gideon is trapped on Ravnica by the Immortal Sun and fights the Dreadhorde with the Boros.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
events.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with Blackblade and draining his essence.

events.summary: Gideon strikes Bolas with the Blackblade, but it breaks against the dragon.
events.quote: He struck Bolas in the head with Blackblade, but the sword broke against the dragon's flesh

events.summary: Gideon sacrifices himself to save Liliana by taking her demonic contract upon himself and dies.
events.quote: Gideon sacrificed himself to save her

events.summary: Liliana, freed, turns the God-Eternals on Bolas and, with Niv-Mizzet's distraction, despark him.
events.quote: Gideon's sacrifice was the deciding factor in the battle

events.summary: A memorial service is held for Gideon on Theros and a statue is erected.
events.quote: A statue was erected in Gideon's honor on Theros as well.

relations.quote: the Gatewatch was soundly defeated by the dragon

relations.quote: who recognized Gideon as one of her own
